meta.title: Medi Waypoint: your care, handed over properly
meta.description: Describe your problem in Bangla or English, get guided to a suitable doctor, and always see who has your request.

hero.headline: Your care, handed over properly.
hero.text: Describe your problem in Bangla or English. We guide you to a suitable doctor, and you can always see who has your request.

problem.title: Where care gets lost
problem.closing: Medi Waypoint keeps track at each handover.

which.p: When you are unwell it is hard to know what kind of doctor you need, or where to find one near you.

records.p: Reports and notes often do not reach the next doctor, so tests and questions are repeated.

word.p: The doctor who refers a patient to a hospital often never learns what happened.

how.title: From first symptom to the right doctor
how.alert: If your answers suggest an emergency, the guide stops and tells you to get emergency care. It does not continue with questions.

tell.title: Tell us what is wrong
tell.text: Speak or type in Bangla or English. Switch language whenever you like.
tell.patient: I have had a fever for three days.

check.title: Check the summary
check.text: Read back what you said and correct anything before a doctor sees it.

choose.title: Choose a doctor and a time
choose.text: See doctors by area and specialty, and ask for a time that suits you.

decide.title: The doctor decides, and you see it
decide.text: The doctor accepts, suggests another time, or declines. Your request shows who has it now.

voice.title: Speak in Bangla or English
voice.text: Use your phone's microphone, or type. Captions are always shown.

typed.title: Type in Bangla or English
typed.text: Write what is wrong in your own words. You can switch language whenever you like.

track.title: Always know who has your request
track.text: Each request shows whether it is with you, the doctor or the hospital.

consent.title: You decide who sees your record
consent.text: A doctor must ask before your record is shared with another hospital. You can say no, and you can withdraw later.

reports.title: Reports checked by a clinician
reports.text: Values read from an uploaded report are marked as drafts until a clinician confirms them.

loop.title: Referrals that come back
loop.text: The receiving hospital acknowledges the referral and records the outcome, and the referring doctor sees it.

emergency.title: Emergency referral without internet
emergency.text: Facility staff can record five essential details offline, print a slip, and the referral is sent when the connection returns.

safety.title: What we do with your information

does.automated: The guide is automated. It does not diagnose, prescribe or decide for a doctor.
does.rules: Danger signs are checked by fixed rules written by clinicians before anything else.
does.consent: Your record is shared with another hospital only after you agree, and you can withdraw.
does.audit: Each time someone opens your record, it is logged.
does.approval: Doctors approve appointments and referrals themselves. A text message can never approve anything.
does.code: You sign in with a code sent to your phone. We do not keep a password for you.

doesNot.emergency: It is not an emergency service.
doesNot.doctor: It does not replace seeing a doctor.
doesNot.training: It does not use your information to train AI models without your explicit permission.

points.words: Explain your problem in your own words
points.find: Find a doctor by area and specialty
points.see: See what is happening with your request

points.queue: One queue of decisions: requests, referrals, reports to verify
points.drafts: AI drafts are marked and need your approval before anything is sent
points.ack: Know when the receiving facility acknowledges, and get the outcome back
points.emergency: Send an emergency referral in five fields, even offline

final.title: Tell us what is wrong.
final.text: It takes a few minutes. You can stop at any time.

footer.description: Care that is handed over properly, from the first symptom to the outcome.
